text:
jess: heads-up — thinking out loud about adding a lightweight 'intake-proxy' between model registry and onboard pipeline. purpose: unify formats, run small perf smoke, and map metadata. tradeoffs?

raj: curious — what's different from current ingest adapter? we already have converter + bench step.

jess: adapter today is per-repo and lives in model repo. proxy would centralize: single binary/service that accepts tarballs, returns normalized manifest + quick bench. pros: fewer divergent adapters, faster iteration. cons: single failure domain, added network hop, versioning complexity.

eva: how heavy is "quick bench"? if it's >200ms per model it's gonna add latency to on-demand intakes. can we async it?

jess: proposal A: sync-fastchecks (checksum, schema, tiny perf run w/ 5 token gen) — aim <500ms. Proposal B: accept and enqueue for full bench; endpoint returns "prevalidated" flag.

sam: we should avoid blocking path for canary imports. suggest header X-accept-async: true. If header present, registry will accept and continue; proxy posts event to bench queue.

morgan: operational concerns: who owns this service? SRE? infra? onboarding team? and what's rollback behavior if proxy mutates model?

jess: ownership: eng-ml owns, infra helps with autoscaling. rollback: proxy keeps original tar and returns digest; any transformation must be deterministic and stored as derived artifact with parent pointer.

raj: durability + security: proxy must run in customer-specific env for private deployments. otherwise we leak model artifacts. need an opt-in for Private.

jess: agreed. proxy will have two modes: hosted (redwood-managed) and sidecar (deployed in customer VPC). sidecar mode streams artifacts to local storage, no plane copies.

eva: metrics: request latency, prevalidated rate, transformed artifact size delta, failure reason taxonomy. also need a "compatibility score" we can attach to model metadata.

sam: compatibility score heuristic: pass rate of microbench tests + golden-output-similarity (bleu / distil-l2) — normalized 0..100. store as model.metadata.compat_score.

morgan: alerting: if transform failure >1% across hour, auto-throttle intake and page eng-ml.

intake-bot: [automated] created bench job 80421 for digest abc123; status: queued.

jess: next steps: 1) prototype proxy binary that only does manifest normalization + checksum 2) add header to registry + queue hook 3) sketch sidecar deployment docs 4) instrument metrics and build compat_score. volunteer for 1: @raj. for 2: @sam. for 3: @morgan. for 4: @eva.

raj: happy to take prototype. will demo Thursday.

eva: i'll draft score calc and minimal golden set.

sam: will add header and queue hook, and put canary toggle behind feature flag.

morgan: i'll write SLOs + deploy runbook.

jess: thanks all. quick sync Fri 11am?

raj: works.

sam: +1
